inheritance_rule: the inherited graphs are sealed evidence. This program appends Substrate native hypotheses and never edits an inherited node

hypotheses.premise: typed regions with declared readers and writers beat one unrestricted shared state of matched capacity on tasks that need cross perspective information
hypotheses.required_bed: a bed where at least two perspectives hold information neither one has alone
hypotheses.required_headroom: residual headroom over the untyped shared state control
hypotheses.strongest_baseline: one opaque state of matched capacity and matched update budget
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: the same tasks with region typing removed and nothing else changed

measurement_boundary.finding: no bed under custody can test H_typed_workspace at the declared SESOI of 0.05. The hypothesis stays untested and the SESOI stays where it was preregistered

hypotheses.premise: a set of heterogeneous perspectives beats the single strongest perspective given the same total compute
hypotheses.required_bed: a bed where the best single perspective leaves measured residual headroom
hypotheses.required_headroom: oracle selection over the perspective set must beat the best fixed single one
hypotheses.strongest_baseline: best single perspective at the full combined budget
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: oracle selection with no headroom over the best single perspective

hypotheses.premise: a learned perspective selector beats the strongest simple selection rule
hypotheses.required_bed: inherits the bed of its predecessor
hypotheses.required_headroom: stable residual headroom beyond reliability weighted selection
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: oracle minus strong simple selection at or below the SESOI

hypotheses.premise: preserving a minority hypothesis through arbitration improves the terminal decision over forcing consensus at the same budget
hypotheses.required_bed: a bed containing items where the majority perspective is wrong
hypotheses.required_headroom: the minority must be correct often enough to be recoverable
hypotheses.strongest_baseline: confidence weighted majority with no minority retention
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: no bed item where the preserved minority changes the terminal answer

hypotheses.premise: owned state restores goals, beliefs and unresolved questions after context removal better than replaying the transcript at a matched token budget
hypotheses.required_bed: tasks that span an enforced interruption and a checkpoint restore
hypotheses.required_headroom: transcript replay must be measurably imperfect at the matched budget
hypotheses.strongest_baseline: full transcript replay truncated to the same budget as the owned state
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: transcript replay matching owned state on every continuity probe

hypotheses.premise: a measured self model improves decisions over a fixed prior of the same form
hypotheses.required_bed: tasks where predicted and actual outcome can both be measured per unit
hypotheses.required_headroom: the fixed prior must be measurably miscalibrated
hypotheses.strongest_baseline: a fixed prior fitted once and never updated
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: the fixed prior already calibrated within the SESOI

hypotheses.premise: verification triggered consolidation beats both no consolidation and a fixed schedule
hypotheses.required_bed: a stream with repeated structure and a verifiable outcome per episode
hypotheses.required_headroom: oracle consolidation must beat no consolidation
hypotheses.strongest_baseline: fixed schedule consolidation at the matched write budget
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: oracle consolidation at or below no consolidation

hypotheses.premise: bounded functional reorganization improves downstream utility beyond fixed and simple routing after its cost is charged
hypotheses.required_bed: a multi domain bed where the useful routing differs by domain
hypotheses.required_headroom: oracle routing must beat fixed routing after cost
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: oracle routing at or below fixed routing once cost is charged

hypotheses.premise: a learned plasticity policy beats the strongest simple plasticity rule
hypotheses.required_bed: inherits the fast state forge beds
hypotheses.required_headroom: stable residual headroom beyond simple rules
